Use a Bevel Cogwheel to transfer rotation around a corner
advancement.petrolsparts.bevel_cogwheel_: Assemble a ball of Cogwheels and Bevel Cogwheels
advancement.petrolsparts.coaxial_gear.de: Turn a Coaxial Cogwheel at a different speed to the Shaft through it
advancement.petrolsparts.colossal_cogwhe: Power 7 other Cogwheels with a single Colossal Cogwheel
advancement.petrolsparts.differential.de: Use a Differential to combine two speeds
Use a Pneumatic Tube to transport an Item
block.petrolsparts.pneumatic_tube.cant_f: The Pneumatic Tube must be empty to change its direction
block.petrolsparts.pneumatic_tube.jammed: There are Items stuck in this Pneumatic Tube that _can't get out_.
petrolsparts.gui.goggles.movement.no_wei: Suitable _weight_ items can be found in JEI. _Right-Click_ to attach one.
petrolsparts.ponder.assemblage.coaxial_c: Coaxial Cogwheels can be placed like Shaftless Cogwheels, and mixed with them in one block
However, they never connect by Shaft to anything
Assemblages of Shaftless and Coaxial Cogwheels can be encased
This is purely cosmetic and has no effect on the Shaft connections
petrolsparts.ponder.assemblage.shaft.tex: Shaft Halves will connect central and face-aligned Cogwheels
Full Shafts will connect all three Shaftless Cogwheels in a block
petrolsparts.ponder.assemblage.shaftless: Shaftless Cogwheels placed in the middle of a block will mesh with Cogwheels...
Shaftless Cogwheels aligned with the faces of blocks will mesh with each other
They also connect to Shafts on the face they are placed on
They will not mesh with misaligned Cogwheels
Multiple Shaftless Cogwheels placed in the same block will rotate independently
petrolsparts.ponder.bevel_cogwheel.text_: Bevel Cogwheels function like partial Gearboxes, propagating rotation around corners
Up to four can be placed in one block
If there are fewer than four, a Shaft can also be added to preserve the rotation direction around that axis
A Shaft can also be placed perpendicular to any Bevel Cogwheels, and will rotate independently
petrolsparts.ponder.bevel_cogwheel.diago: Bevel Cogwheels can be mounted diagonally off the sides of small Cogwheels
They propagate rotation as shown, conserving the speed
Two opposite diagonal Bevel Cogwheels can be placed in the same block, and they will rotate independently
petrolsparts.ponder.bevel_cogwheel.encas: Diagonally-mounted Bevel Cogwheels can be encased
petrolsparts.ponder.brass_depot.header: Filtering Recipes with the Brass Depot
petrolsparts.ponder.brass_depot.text_1: Brass Depots have a filter slot that can be used in case of conflicting recipes
petrolsparts.ponder.brass_depot.text_2: This works for a variety of Recipe types
petrolsparts.ponder.colossal_cogwheel.te: We're going to need more space.
The Colossal Cogwheel can mesh with Large Cogwheels, and will rotate at a third of the speed
They can also connect to smaller Cogwheels, and will rotate at a sixth of the speed
They can even connect on the inside, propagating with a factor of three
petrolsparts.ponder.corner_shaft.header: Relaying rotational force with Corner Shafts
petrolsparts.ponder.corner_shaft.text_1: Corner Shafts can relay rotatation around a corner
petrolsparts.ponder.corner_shaft.text_2: Use a Wrench to rotate them around the axis you clicked
petrolsparts.ponder.differential.text_1: Differentials rotate at the average speed of the two input Shafts
petrolsparts.ponder.differential.text_2: When connected to a small Cog, this is effectively summing the two speeds
petrolsparts.ponder.differential.text_6: Shafts spinning in the opposite direction are treated like negative numbers
petrolsparts.ponder.friction_heater.head: Heating things up with the Friction Heater
petrolsparts.ponder.friction_heater.text: Friction Heaters convert rotation into Blaze Burner heat
They must be powered from both sides
How hot they get depends on the difference in speed between each wheel
If both sides are spinning in the same direction, they will not heat anything
Friction Heaters can heat anything a Blaze Burner can, even with a Blaze Cake
petrolsparts.ponder.hydraulic_transmissi: Do you hate the core gameplay mechanic of Create?
The Hydraulic Transmission can make almost any connection
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_1: Right-Click the Movement with a suitable item to load a weight
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_2: A list of such items can be found in JEI
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_3: The Movement can now be wound from the back
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_4: The weight used affects the Stress Impact
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_5: Power the Movement to start releasing stored Stress from the front
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_6: Again, the Stress Capacity depends on the weight loaded
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_7: The output of Movements will also carry to Cuckoo Clocks placed above
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_8: Wrenching or breaking the Movement will preserve its weight and charge
petrolsparts.ponder.movement.text_9: Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the weight
petrolsparts.ponder.movement_battery.hea: A Kinetic Battery Made with the Movement
petrolsparts.ponder.movement_battery.tex: This simple kinetic battery charges when there is excess Stress Capacity and discharges when there is less
petrolsparts.ponder.overload_clutch.head: Segmenting kinetic networks with the Overload Clutch
petrolsparts.ponder.overload_clutch.text: Overload Clutches will propagate a set amount of Stress
If the output network becomes overstressed, the input network is unaffected
The maximum amount of conveyed stress can be configured on the side
Powering the Overload Clutch with Redstone will reduced the conveyed Stress...
...all the way down to zero at full power
Multiple Overload Clutches can be used in parallel to increase the stress to a subnetwork
petrolsparts.ponder.planetary_gearset.he: Out-of-this-world gearing with the Planetary Gearset
petrolsparts.ponder.planetary_gearset.te: Planetary Gearsets connect almost identically to Large Cogwheels
However, the Shaft of a Planetary Gearset rotates twice as fast, and in the opposite direction to the teeth
petrolsparts.ponder.pneumatic_tube.heade: Transporting items with the Pneumatic Tube
petrolsparts.ponder.pneumatic_tube.text_: Place two Pneumatic Tube Blocks and use a few more to connect them
If either (or both) ends are given rotational power, Pneumatic Tubes can move items between inventories a stack at a time
The extracted items can be filtered on the input end
If the output end has no connected inventory, it will shoot the items out
The direction of transport can be inverted as long as the Tube is empty
pquality_effect.petrolsparts.friction_he: Friction Heaters require %2$sx the wheel speed difference to heat
